_doc: Fixed, hand-placed story items (docs/gravelight/LORE.md section 13.1). StoryProp.spawn_all(map, map_key) spawns every entry whose map matches, at position (map frame: +X east, +Z south, y up) with yaw in degrees (0 = the front faces -Z; 90 faces -X; -90 faces +X; 180 faces +Z). Flat styles (guest_book, logbook, letter) sit on the surface at position.y; wall styles (drawing, docket, clipping) hang with their back on the wall face at position. id must be an intel.json row with placement fixed. 'where' is a note for people. hidden_until_flag (optional, T-154): the item is invisible and can't be read until that GameState flag is set.
